column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?
#Text=A small piece of land in the middle of the water with a bridge crossing the water, but which must necessarily connect to another land area.
#Text=It is a rough map with very few details, so it is probably a tourist guide to help locate points of interest.
#Text=We can see that there is a fishing area, an area where you can ride a bike in the north, an area to visit, a carousel, two restaurants, a hotel, and restrooms.
#Text=There are a few main roads with street names, and in the middle, commercial areas and residential areas.
#Text=There is some greenery around the edges, probably wooded or grassy areas.
